game_title: Vowel Counter – Supply Cache Camp Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp, a high supply cache: the summit pilot must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp: a high supply cache
core_gameplay_loop: In Supply Cache Camp, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Each round, a new ice axes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the vowels value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 290 points of ice axes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

code_snippet:
for ch in word:

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vowels changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Supply Cache Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
